sharedStoryClusters.story: French Unrest and Curfews Imposed
sharedStoryClusters.summary: Following severe riots, looting, and nearly 2,400 arrests across France over rising living costs and school conditions—with unrest spilling across borders into Milan and Brussels and students blockading the Louvre—French authorities enacted localized curfews in Paris, Nice, and other cities while acknowledging severe security underpreparedness, initiating cleanups, and facing heavy merchant losses amid rising pressure on President Macron.
